title: Rate Declaration Schedule — Ashgrove Fixed Indexed Annuities Strategies, Initial Rates and Guaranteed Minimums
content:
### Crediting strategies

Every Fixed Indexed Annuities tier offers the same three crediting strategies:

1. the fixed account;
2. the S&P 500 annual point-to-point cap strategy;
3. the S&P 500 annual point-to-point participation strategy.

### Rates declared for the first contract year, and guaranteed minimums

| Rate | IndexEdge 5 | IndexEdge 7 | IndexEdge 10 | IndexEdge 10 Bonus | IncomeShield 7 | IncomeShield 10 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fixed account rate, first contract year (annual) | 3.75% | 4.00% | 4.25% | 3.50% | 3.25% | 3.25% |
| Lowest fixed account rate ever declared (annual) | 1% | 1% | 1% | 1% | 1% | 1% |
| Annual point-to-point cap, first contract year | 8.5% | 9.5% | 10.5% | 8.0% | 7.0% | 7.5% |
| Lowest cap ever declared | 1% | 1% | 1% | 1% | 1% | 1% |
| Annual point-to-point participation rate, first contract year | 40% | 45% | 50% | 35% | 30% | 32% |
| Lowest participation rate ever declared | 10% | 10% | 10% | 10% | 10% | 10% |
| Index floor (lowest index credit rate on any indexed strategy) | 0% | 0% | 0% | 0% | 0% | 0% |

Rates for later contract years are declared on each anniversary; the "lowest ever declared" rows are the guaranteed minimums those declarations never go beneath.

### Allocation terms

| Term | All six tiers |
|---|---|
| Reallocation window before a contract anniversary | 30 calendar days |
| Allocation increment | whole multiples of 5% |

### Points of reading

- The cap and the participation rate are separate rates for separate strategies: the cap row applies to money in the cap strategy, the participation row to money in the participation strategy.
- An allocation of 35% fixed account, 40% cap strategy and 25% participation strategy uses whole multiples of 5%; an allocation using 33% does not (hypothetical allocations).
- An index floor of 0% means no indexed strategy ever credits a negative rate on any tier.
